Dash & Slash

About Dash & Slash

You are a swift stickman ninja armed with a sword. Choose a direction, launch into a lightning-fast dash, and eliminate opponents before they can stop you. Each arena is a short test of planning and reflexes. Plot your path, avoid danger, and find the right sequence of strikes to leave no enemy standing. - One-motion controls - Rapid sword attacks - Enemies and dangerous obstacles - Short, dynamic levels - Tests of agility and precision

How to play

On desktop hold the left mouse button point in the direction you want to move and release to launch the character into a sword dash On a phone or tablet swipe across the screen in the desired direction Aim the hero directly at enemies avoid danger
